description: The file defines the EnforcePasswordRequest class within the OrangeHRM project, which represents a database entity for handling password enforcement requests. It includes properties such as user, request date, reset code, and expiration status, along with corresponding getter and setter methods. The class uses Doctrine ORM annotations for mapping to the database.

classes.name: EnforcePasswordRequest
classes.description: Represents a password enforcement request entity, including properties for user association, request date, reset code, and expiration status, with ORM annotations for database mapping.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the enforce password request.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the enforce password request.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns the user associated with the password reset request.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Associates a User object with this enforce password request.

methods.name: getResetRequestDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the password reset was requested.

methods.name: setResetRequestDate
methods.description: Sets the date when the password reset was requested.

methods.name: getResetCode
methods.description: Returns the reset code for password verification.

methods.name: setResetCode
methods.description: Sets the reset code for password verification.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks whether the password reset request has expired.

methods.name: setExpired
methods.description: Marks the password reset request as expired or not.
